decisions.WAIT_FOR_FINALIZED_GSC: Latest finalized GSC date is less than 7 days after verified release.
decisions.HOLD_LOW_VISIBILITY: Date gate passed but fewer than 8/40 W1 URLs have impressions.
decisions.REVIEW_PENDING_INDEXATION: Visibility gate passed but indexation evidence is absent or below 80%.
decisions.OWNERSHIP_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Too many parent-child pairs show meaningful shared-query overlap; review before W2.
decisions.ROUND2_REVIEW_ELIGIBLE: All observation gates passed. Manual W2 candidate review may begin; W2 remains locked until manually approved.

hardRules: No Brand×District or Series×District expansion from observation data alone
